claims.statement: EasySAM test suite is organized into four categories: example generation tests that call generate() and assert on template.yml output, local validation tests that call resources() and assert on schema errors, local execution tests that exercise create_app() with TestClient against examples, and an example smoke test script that invokes the CLI generate command on every example/ directory.

Example generation tests follow a consistent pattern: register YAML constructors for !GetAtt, !Sub, and !Ref SAM tags; call generate() with cliparams and deploy_ctx; assert no errors (or expected errors for error-case tests); and read template.yml to assert on Resources structure.

scripts/test_examples_generation.py iterates all subdirectories in example/, runs 'uv run easysam --aws-profile easysam-a --environment easysamdev --target-region us-east-1 generate <path>' on each, expects appwitherrors to fail, and exits non-zero if any unexpected failure occurs. This validates the CLI-to-template pipeline, distinct from pytest generation tests that call generate() directly.

Local validation tests call easysam.load.resources() directly with temporary directories containing crafted resources.yaml and easysam.yaml files, asserting on error messages for invalid sections, missing required fields, invalid integrations, and memory constraints, or asserting on successful resource_data structure.

Local execution tests exercise the local development server (easysam.local_server) using fastapi.testclient.TestClient: test_local_e2e.py tests full flow against example/myapp; test_local_server.py tests create_app() and normalize_response(); test_local_routes.py tests build_routes() for greedy paths and function URLs; test_local_event.py tests REST/HTTP API event builders; test_local_handler.py tests handler isolation and async support; test_local_envvars.py tests .env loading and template interpolation.

The test suite covers all major example features: myapp (lambda+API+DynamoDB), onelambda (lambda-only), conditionals (!Conditional resolution), appwitherrors (validation errors), aoss (OpenSearch Serverless), prismarine/prismarine_all (TypedDict tables), functionurl (Lambda Function URLs), plugins (template rendering), customlayer (SSM layers), dynamottl (DynamoDB TTL), userenvvars (global envvars), kinesismutltiplebuckets (Kinesis multi-bucket), envvars_expansion (.env expansion), and greedy_paths (path normalization).

Local execution tests use FastAPI TestClient to verify HTTP routing, CORS headers, event format variations (v1 REST vs v2 HTTP API), auth context injection, greedy path handling, function URL routes, and handler module isolation between lambdas with same-named helpers.

test_local_validation.py validates schema error messages for unexpected sections (Additional properties), missing required fields (name required), invalid integrations (path required), and numeric constraints (memory minimum 128), using tmp_path fixtures to create isolated test projects.
